u0: Before the first fall: you are holding the box and no recovery is currently due. Continue carrying it and watch for the scheduled slip; when box_fell fires, react by picking it up on the very next move.
u1: The box has just fallen and your hands are empty. The active objective is to pick it up on your very next move: doing so earns the first recovery reward and moves to u2. Any ordinary step without holding the box misses that immediate pickup and falls into the failed state u5.
u2: The first fall has been recovered by picking the box up immediately, so the box is in your hands and the first recovery requirement is satisfied. Keep possession; if another fall occurs, respond to it and pick it up on the very next move.
u3: The box has fallen again after the first successful recovery, leaving your hands empty. The active objective is again the immediate response: pick it up on your very next move to earn the second recovery reward and reach u4; otherwise the opportunity is missed and the machine goes to u5.
u4: The second immediate recovery is complete: the box is back in your hands and all fall-recovery rewards have been earned. No further pickup response is required; keep possession and continue in this satisfied final state.
u5: A fall-recovery opportunity was missed by not picking the box up on the very next move. This is an absorbing failure state: no further recovery reward is available, even if the box is later retrieved physically.
